display_title: Because I Loved You So Much
description:
*“You think I don't know? How satisfied could you have been to bear two children from another man?”*

The bitter relationship with Do-Gyeol ended after two years of a sponsorship arrangement, leaving only deep scars. He reappeared before Bo-Mi, who had secretly borne his twins and raised them alone. Unwilling to lose her children too, Bo-Mi lies by inventing a nonexistent husband, but Do-Gyeol sneers as he thrusts the sponsorship contract at her...

*“Even if you spread your legs for any man and got knocked up, our contract still isn't over.”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
